verdict.rationale: v0's docs describe on-demand code generation, GitHub integration, deployments, and API access, but there is no evidence of scheduled/triggered automations or background agentic tasks that run autonomously without a user-initiated chat or API call (e.g., no cron jobs, webhooks, or persistent background workers are described). The closest features (auto-fix on CI failure, 'Fix with v0') are triggered by user action or CI events within a user-initiated flow, not autonomous background automation.
